structural_change: DRIVE-S81-LEPENH 10-20 s81sl_lepenh_d3a DIAGNOSTIC stand-in parent (never bindable), successor of s81sl_lepenh_d2 (d2b CTS: all parent flops in the 129.6-um channel but 3 E-face port flops stretched both CTS boxes to 1150x700 um, depth 20-23, TT spread 800 ps; channel over-dense, 111k hold buffers, GRT congested). See mk_d3.py: real-size lep_nh (475.2x561.6), channel 172.8, re-ranged line ports, fault/rst_n pins moved toward the channel; d3a: port flops unanchored (place with their loads), PD 0.45.
